temporal_state_chain.observed: Arthur notices that Teresa seems overburdened with her tasks during the community service project and appears overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Arthur had no specific belief that Teresa needed help with this task; he had not yet assessed her workload as requiring assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — observing Teresa overwhelmed leads him to believe she needs help and is in need of support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs assistance and may be overburdened; her well-being should be considered.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and empathetic for Teresa's well-being.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to help Teresa with some of her tasks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa hesitates to accept help and says she wants to show she can do it by herself; she responds positively when Arthur reassures her that accepting help does not mean she is incapable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Teresa confirms his inference and also accepts his reassurance, so his belief shifts toward her being more open to teamwork while still valuing self-reliance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to prove she can handle things herself, but she can understand that accepting help does not undermine her abilities.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa that accepting help does not diminish her capability and continue supporting her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa admits the day has been busy and she feels like she is falling behind; she agrees to try working together on the tasks as a team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believed his earlier reassurance had helped Teresa feel supported and that she was more open to accepting teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he recognizes that despite his reassurance, Teresa is still struggling and his efforts have not yet yielded enough results.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is still struggling, but she is willing to try a shared approach; he needs to support her in a way that does not make her feel inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate, and try working together as a team.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees that working together feels less overwhelming and accepts Arthur's proposed division of tasks with regular check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After Teresa agreed to try working together, he believed the collaborative approach could help ease her burden and improve efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Teresa's positive response confirms and strengthens his belief that collaboration is effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Working together will ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency; the collaborative approach is promising and worth committing to.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach: handle inventory while Teresa manages patient records and check in with each other regularly.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa says their teamwork paid off, calls it a great experience, and agrees that they should continue collaborating in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He believed their collaboration had been effective and was improving their working relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Teresa's agreement confirms and strengthens his belief that collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship, and continuing it in future projects would be beneficial.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects with Teresa.
